items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Mary' only in the interviewer's question ('when did you first start to pick up on an instrument, Mary?'). There is no content from the interviewee describing a relationship with Mary.

ctx.x: This is real three, Emil Bonds. We were talking about Buddy Petit, huh? That's right. Joe Petit. I mean Joe Petit, the vowel trombone. The vowel trombones. So they had the trombones in those little bands that went around house to house, huh? Oh yeah, but they didn't have the trombone that went around then, I remember. Oh, they didn't have trombone? No. No trombone. No trombone. I see. Well, when did you first start to pick up on an instrument, Mary? Your dad didn't play, did he?
No, my dad didn't play anything. But I was watching, and I thought I'd pick it up. Tell the children about it, Bunk is the first one ever quality for me. Bunk?
